summary: Iter 243 - Skip-Reason Feature fully tested. Backend: 17/18 pytest tests passed (1 skipped). Frontend: All UI components verified working including Skip-Reason Picker with 4 reasons (Krank 🤒, Homeoffice 🏠, Urlaub 🌴, Sonstiges ❔) + hard-delete option, and OfficeWeekWidget absent display with emoji + name.

issues: WebSocket connection warnings in console (non-blocking, reconnection works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 243 fully tested. Skip-Reason feature: (1) GET /api/office-days/skip-reasons returns 4 reasons with id, emoji, label_de, label_en. (2) POST /api/users/me/office-days/skip with reason sets status='cancelled' + skip_reason (soft-delete). (3) POST skip without reason hard-deletes booking. (4) Invalid reason returns 400. (5) Non-existent booking returns 404. (6) Other user's booking returns 404. (7) GET /api/resources-office-week now includes 'absent' and 'absent_count' fields per day. Cancelled bookings with skip_reason appear in absent array with emoji/reason_label. (8) Privacy filter hide_from_office_widget=true filters user from absent list. Frontend: Profile page OfficeDaysSection shows Skip button (data-testid='office-day-skip-{id}') that opens Reason-Picker (data-testid='office-day-skip-reasons-{id}') with 4 reason buttons (data-testid='skip-reason-{reason}-{id}') + none button for hard-delete. Dashboard OfficeWeekWidget shows absent section (data-testid='office-week-absent-{weekday}') with emoji + first name.
